bro.text: Kayla bin-Kroog wins Urza's hand when he lifts the statue with an automaton, and she becomes Queen of Kroog, refusing the title Warlady, while Urza leads the nation's armies.

At the peace talks Urza refuses to hand the Mightstone to Mishra and argues loudly with Kayla, and the Mightstone is stolen and the stones battle, after which Kroog falls to Mishra's dragon engines, and Tawnos and Kayla escape by boat with Ashnod's help.

Five years after the cataclysm, Kayla rules Penregon with Tawnos and his civil automatons, and she refuses to forgive Tawnos for convincing her to let her son Harbin go off and die in her husband's war.

When Raddic's crusade of penitents comes against the machines, Kayla lets refugees in but not soldiers and orders Tawnos to arm the civils, and later, as glaciers advance, she learns to control the magic that bursts from her hands and leads a final caravan west out of Penregon.
